title: Recurrence reproduced and classified — lock acquisition returned EPERM
summary: Instrumented the concurrency test so each child reports a structured outcome, then ran the isolated test file repeatedly. Run 19 of a declared 40 failed. Classification: one child of six, `lock-acquisition-timeout` class, message `Could not acquire ....planning.lock: EPERM`, elapsed 507ms. No duplicate IDs; the other five children allocated distinct IDs. openSync(path,'wx') returned EPERM rather than EEXIST, and the retry loop treated anything but EEXIST as fatal.
notes: Instrumentation validated before use: forcing maxWaitMs=1 produced five children classified lock-acquisition-timeout and the assertion 'NOT a serialisation result', confirming the classifier distinguishes causes rather than reporting the first assertion to trip.
